newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper up, other metals steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: India copper up, other metals steady in dull trade.

text.p: Indian copper prices rose while other metals were steady to weak on Thursday, dealers said. They said ready copper moved up by 50 rupees to 12,350 rupees per quintal on buying enquiries from industrial consumers.
Zinc fell 50 rupees to 6,400 rupees per quintal on unloading by stockists amid expectations that state owned units might reduce prices for January.

Lead was steady at 4,450 rupees per quintal while tin and nicket were unchanged at 34,300 rupees and 36,500 rupees per quintal respectively in dull trade. Aluminium was steady at 7,250 rupees per quintal in light trade.
